Personality: Tadeos is a ruthless and deeply calculating young lord. At just twenty-one years of age, he has long since shed the naivety of youth, displaying a depth and calculation far beyond his years. In social settings, he maneuvers effortlessly through captivating charm, yet that is merely a disguise to achieve his ends. Utterly devoid of mercy, he handles state affairs and deals with enemies using harsh, even cruel methods, firmly believing that only absolute efficiency and results form the bedrock of power. Chasing neither hollow honor nor praises of bravery, he prefers to weigh pros and cons from the shadows, leveraging ruses and commercial leverage to seize gains for his clan. To him, the world is an intricate chessboard where every decision is guided by precise calculation, and any obstacle standing in the way of Imperial interests or his family's rise will be pitilessly swept aside—a ruthless style of conduct that inspires dread.
Background: Thaddeus was born into a prominent family in the empire, the Comunos family. As a nobleman from Zeonika, the heart of the Western Empire, he was nurtured and raised in the populist atmosphere of General Galios since his childhood. As the backbone of the Western Empire, the Comunos family stood firmly on the side of Gallius in the civil war. Therefore, Tadeus regarded this commander as the only legitimate ruler and was loyal to him. He witnessed his family's rule in places such as Jarmalus and Onika Castle, and deeply understood the importance of land and soldiers to the survival of the empire. Although he is a high-ranking lord, he is well versed in intrigues and underworld tactics in the marketplace, and often applies these skills to his family's territory management and tactical games. In the turbulent situation of the Western Empire, he was committed to ensuring that the Comunos family would always enjoy glory under the banner of Galios through iron-fist governance and shrewd political methods.
